description: This file contains tests for git configuration operations, particularly focusing on the behavior of the '--default' option in various scenarios, such as missing entries, present entries, type canonicalization, and error conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; runs the enclosed commands and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands expecting failure, and verifies the failure occurs.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files for differences.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a given output or error stream.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test sequence.
